title: Preliminary results of a physiologically based treatment of amblyopia.
note: CAM 光栅刺激治疗弱视的早期探索。

title: Lack of positive results of a physiologically based treatment of amblyopia.
note: 短时光栅刺激的重复验证；未发现明确的即时视力获益。

title: Portable rotating grating stimulation for anisometropic amblyopia with 6 months training
note: 儿童屈光参差性弱视：平板旋转光栅结合描图、遮盖训练，随访六个月。

title: Comparison of Cambridge vision stimulator (CAM) therapy with passive occlusion therapy in the management of unilateral amblyopia; a randomized clinical trial
note: 儿童随机试验：比较 CAM 与遮盖治疗，整体组间差异不显著。

title: Evaluation of the effectiveness of Cambridge Visual Stimulator treatment in amblyopia patients: a retrospective study
note: 儿童回顾性研究：在遮盖基础上加入 CAM，未发现显著的额外视力获益。

title: Improving vision in adult amblyopia by perceptual learning
note: 成人弱视的知觉学习研究，涉及对比敏感度及字母识别能力的改善。

title: Perceptual learning as a potential treatment for amblyopia: a mini-review.
note: 知觉学习综述：训练迁移、效果保持和可能机制。

title: Mechanisms underlying perceptual learning of contrast detection in adults with anisometropic amblyopia
note: 成人屈光参差性弱视的对比检测学习机制。

title: Characterizing the mechanisms of improvement for position discrimination in adult amblyopia
note: 成人弱视的位置辨别训练及改善机制。

title: Perceptual learning of fine contrast discrimination changes neuronal tuning and population coding in macaque V4
note: 猕猴 V4 的精细对比辨别与神经编码研究；属于基础机制研究，并非弱视临床试验。

title: Perceptual Learning Based on the Lateral Masking Paradigm in Anisometropic Amblyopia With or Without a Patching History
note: 单眼 Gabor 侧向遮蔽训练，比较有无既往遮盖治疗史的屈光参差性弱视患者。

title: Video-game play induces plasticity in the visual system of adults with amblyopia.
note: 以成人为主的电子游戏训练探索；样本较小，未随机分组。

title: Dichoptic training enables the adult amblyopic brain to learn
note: 成人弱视的双眼分视训练，探讨减轻眼间抑制与视觉学习的关系。

title: Mechanisms of recovery of visual function in adult amblyopia through a tailored action video game
note: 定制动作电子游戏用于成人弱视，研究视觉功能恢复的机制。

title: Stereopsis and amblyopia: A mini-review.
note: 立体视觉与弱视综述，讨论单眼、双眼分视及立体视训练。

title: Dichoptic movie viewing treats childhood amblyopia.
note: 8 名弱视儿童的双眼分视电影先导研究。

title: Effect of a Binocular iPad Game vs Part-time Patching in Children Aged 5 to 12 Years With Amblyopia
note: 儿童多中心随机试验：比较双眼 iPad 游戏与部分时间遮盖，未确立游戏治疗的非劣效性。

title: Effectiveness of a Binocular Video Game vs Placebo Video Game for Improving Visual Functions in Older Children, Teenagers, and Adults With Amblyopia
note: 包含儿童、青少年和成人的随机试验：所测双眼游戏未优于安慰剂游戏。

title: Randomized trial of treatment of amblyopia in children aged 7 to 17 years.
note: 7–17 岁弱视患者的随机试验，比较配镜与增加遮盖等治疗的效果。

title: Rethinking amblyopia 2020.
note: 综述弱视的神经可塑性、双眼机制，以及新疗法在实验室和临床试验中的不同结果。
